Print/console debugging
The browser DevTools console

gaps.title: When not to trust the AI
gaps.recommendation: Strengthen trust calibration, sycophancy, automation bias, and independent checks.
gaps.why: The course drills check-the-facts but not the quieter trap: the model agreeing with you, and you leaning on it too hard.
subtopics: Sycophancy: the model mirrors your framing and validates a leading question
Countermeasures, don't lead, ask it to argue the opposite/steelman, ask 'what am I getting wrong?', never treat agreement as confirmation
Over-reliance and automation bias: skill atrophy, offloading judgment on irreversible calls
Calibrate trust to stakes (low = accept, high = verify or human sign-off)
Keep a manual baseline
Cross-model verification as a cheap independent check: paste the same question to a different model and see where they disagree
The human counterweight to the whole 'delegate to AI' arc

gaps.title: Reading a number without getting fooled
gaps.recommendation: Add numeric and chart verification before learners act on generated analysis.
gaps.why: The check-the-source rule is built for text, not for a number or a chart. There's nothing on sanity-checking a figure the model gives you.
subtopics: Correlation vs causation
Outlier
Sample size ('is 12 data points enough?')
Base rate
False precision (4 decimals on garbage)
Average vs median vs distribution
'does this chart's axis lie', truncated y-axis, cherry-picked window, dual axes
The numeric version of 'verify every output' for a CIO acting on an AI-made chart

gaps.title: Set up a reusable assistant: Custom GPTs, Projects, Gems
gaps.recommendation: Add a saved-assistant lab after the assistant comparison.
gaps.why: The course only shows one-off chatting, never the saved, file-backed assistant that separates a power user from a dabbler.
subtopics: Build a Custom GPT, a ChatGPT/Claude Project, a Gemini Gem: system instructions + uploaded knowledge (SOPs, a rate ordinance, style samples) + persona
Canvas / Artifacts as the side-by-side editing workspace
Connectors wiring the assistant to Gmail/Drive
Re-invoking a saved assistant instead of re-pasting context every time
When each beats a plain chat

gaps.title: Drop in a spreadsheet and ask AI about it

'what's driving the spike?', 'chart monthly non-revenue water', 'find the outliers'
Which assistants actually crunch numbers vs just chat
File-size/row limits
It writes hidden Python for you
Downloading the chart / cleaned file back out
The honest failure mode: it silently miscomputes, re-ask, spot-check one row by hand

gaps.title: Use AI inside Excel and Google Sheets
gaps.recommendation: Add formula, cleanup, and spreadsheet-native AI practice.
gaps.why: Spreadsheets show up only as messy data to fix, never as a tool you drive with AI to write formulas and clean a file.

Prompt-to-formula (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, a pivot table)
'explain this formula', 'find the error in this sheet'
The =formula bar, A1/$A$1 refs, CSV vs XLSX
AI-assisted cleanup on a real file: dedupe rows, standardize 'N. Plant' vs 'North Plant', split a stuck column, flag blanks
Spot-checking the AI's work, the step before any analysis

gaps.title: Deep research done right: NotebookLM and Perplexity, hands-on
gaps.recommendation: Turn the existing research coverage into an end-to-end sourced research lab.
